audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is inverted from content win[]: full has Pyke on rows 0-3 and Skill on rows 4-6, while content win[] (and the packet's levelChart) has Skill on rows 0-3 and Pyke on rows 4-6.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 are a genuine spacing/skill duel — bomb range vs. Bone Skewer poke, neither side snowballing cleanly. From Level 6 on, Death From Below's execute-and-reset out-tempos a single Chronoshift, and lethality picks plus stealth roams outscale peel — content win[] and the packet already agree on this shape.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Skill, phases[4-6].side -> Pyke, all six why fields rewritten to match; win[] is left alone since it already holds the correct verdict.

audit.why: Level 6 execute-reset spike, first-item lethality spike, and late roam pressure are already named with real abilities in spikes[] and breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Bone Skewer (Q) is a channel Time Bomb (Q) cancels outright, and that Pyke's Gift of the Drowned Ones bypasses stacked resistances — neither is on the page. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed from tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.corrected: Added the channel-interrupt interaction and a note against stacking pure armour/MR, gave breakdown.cooldowns real numbers, and replaced the bled bullets with matchup-specific text.
